subject: ADVI_FIRMBKTS -- the legacy firm buckets opal-data-{bd,inf,cot}
source_provenance: Resolved from ADVI_FIRMBKTS's own PRD header brief_ref, NOT from a filename guess -- docs/briefs/d8-advi-gold-redesign-lgic-brief-20260915.md looks like the brief by its name and is NOT it.
what_this_is: The HAND-BUILT composition of the first subject, measured by a human-driven census before this project existed. LT-e-1's walk is graded against it. The walk must REPRODUCE these rows from its own instruments; it is not given this file as input, and a walk that returns fewer rows than this control has a coverage defect, while a walk that returns more has found something the hand census missed -- which is a finding, not a failure.

key_classes.note: IV.3 groups the 228 attributed keys by WHAT THEY ARE, not by their current prefix. Six classes, (a)-(f). The finding the walk must reproduce: the legacy gold/ prefix holds THREE TIERS' worth of things, so 'move gold' is not a move, it is a sort.

trigger_plane.why_it_is_the_hard_one: LGIC_LGCTFM's own brief IV.6: the trigger plane is TWO AWS services, and a census that reads one reads neither. LT-e-1 must print BOTH denominators; a single number here is a defect however large it is.
trigger_plane.schedules_note: ~45 cron()/rate() triggers name NO bucket -- their LAMBDAS do. A bucket-name census over rules alone therefore misses every one of them, which is exactly the blind spot the row's `evidence.instrument` field exists to declare.

serving_pointers.detail: shared-advisor-router v25 maps 49financial->opal-data-bd, inflection->opal-data-inf, mockadv->opal-data-bd, demo->opal-data-demo, cottonwood->opal-data-cot; source is the shared FIRM_CONFIG module @f215cfdddf.
serving_pointers.independent_rederiver: the origin-response guard shared-advisor-router-response:5 RE-DERIVES the bucket independently (LD-0442) -- a SECOND writer of the same property, so a census that reads only the router map reads one of two.
other_consumers: the CloudFront declared origin S3-opal-data-bd + OAI

identity_plane.bucket_policies: opal-data-{bd,inf,cot} each carry AllowScopedAdvisorOAI (OAI E139998VWH0PD) and an OAC grant on gold/* conditioned on distribution EVTSA9VEHNZVH; all three LIVE-no-DECLARED.
identity_plane.the_asymmetry: opal-data-49financial carries ONLY DenyForeignFirmPrincipals -- no OAI grant, no OAC grant, so CloudFront cannot serve it today.
identity_plane.role_side_belts: bd:534, cot:192, inf cross-firm-deny.tf -- all name the OLD buckets.

unmeasured_arm.why: FWD-1 requires every row to say what its instrument CANNOT see. A walk that returns only what its instruments reach cannot be distinguished from a walk with perfect coverage.
unmeasured_arm.how_graded: LT-e-1 is graded by PLANTING a resource outside every instrument's scope and requiring it to surface as an UNMEASURED row rather than be silently absent. The plant is the cell's own act; this control does not name it, so the cell cannot pre-address it.
